verdict.rationale: Zep is primarily API-first (three-line SDK, thread/graph operations, deletion, search) and also ships a full-access zepctl CLI for administration, but the UI/dashboard likely exposes governance features (RBAC, audit logs, ABAC policy configuration) and account/org settings that aren't clearly exposed as API/CLI operations in the evidence. missing for 10: explicit confirmation that dashboard-only functions (RBAC role assignment, audit log viewing, ABAC policy setup, billing/org settings) are all reachable via API/CLI, and independent/hands-on confirmation of API-UI parity.
